翌日，一早江流匆匆的赶到学徒广场。不一会，四十二个学徒帮众全部都到齐。马师傅跟着不久也到了，随即，目光在众学徒身上一扫，转头喊道:"小青!把计时沙漏打开!""是!马师傅!"小青应道。马师傅跟着就运起气血威压笼罩着全场。很快就有两个学徒，承受不住气血威压。先生跪了下去，最后趴在地上。马师傅扭头看了一下计时沙漏。跟着手一挥，立马就有两个杂务堂帮众，把那两个人拉了下去。马师傅没有再去理会那两个学徒，持续加大气血威压。不久，就陆陆续续的有人承受不住血气威压被压跪了下去，没多大一会，广场上就趴倒了一片。到最后，场上只剩下江流，王壮，潘端。还在坚持。又过了一刻钟左右，最后终于江流也坚持不住了。江流倒下去之前，看见只剩自己在坚持了。马师傅看见已经没人再站立着了，这才收起气血威压。看了一眼计时沙漏，说道:"你们都已经修炼了有一个半月了。最先承受不住的，那是还没进入炼肉的。已经不值得帮里花费大量资源去培养了!""至于他们之前花费的资源用度，要嘛喊家里人加倍帮忙付清!要嘛让他们自己在帮派的杂务堂做事还清!""你们应该要知道，帮派花在你们身上的每一份修炼资源，都是来之不易!希望你们好自为之!"说完，马师傅就转身潇洒地走了。江流看着马师傅远去的背影!心想:这是说赶人就赶人!连招呼都不给你打的啊!江流其实来到这个世界已经半年多了。刚开始在街上混的时候，就知道帮派做的恶事不少。坑蒙拐骗是正常的了，更有些采生折割都时有出现。刚开始看见这些的时候，江流被吓得几天睡不着，晚晚做噩梦，生怕自己有天也会落得那一下场。还好，江流穿越过来的时候，年纪已经不算小了。不然的话，下场绝对不会比那些人好。就算是这样，隔壁邻居都打算来吃绝户了。还好江流苏醒得及时。不然的话，现在肯定是在要饭。就凭那么弱小的身体，要饭都会被别人欺负。所以江流对于那两个被拖走的学徒，只是内心略微有点同情，跟着就毫无波澜了。毕竟帮里都已经提供那么好的环境了，自己却不努力，能怪谁？倒是其他学徒看见这一幕，好几个大呼小叫的喊了起来!说什么马师傅太冷酷无情了，应该再给他们一次机会什么的。小青听到这样的言论，马上训斥道:"背后议论马师傅的，今天的汤药供应减半!再有下次，直接取消一天的汤药供应。小杰，你把名单记一下!""有谁感觉处罚得过分的，你们可以自己帮他们把花费补上。别说不给这个你们机会!""还有，别以为你们的时间很充裕。下个月马师傅还会继续考核的，考核不过的，你们的待遇就是跟今天被赶走的两人一样。下场是怎样？相信你们也知道了。"小青说完，就不再管这些学徒，背着双手走了。他也是要抓紧时间修炼的。哪里有那么多空闲的时间去管他们这些闲事？如果不是来这里管这些学徒，可以得贡献点和捞些好处。鬼才来呢!毕竟混帮派的，武功不好的话，随时都有生命之虞，明天死在哪里都不知道呢。众学徒一听，立马就没有兴趣继续讨论了。各自开始今天的修炼，毕竟下次考核不过，被赶走的可就是他们了，谁还有闲心去管别人？江流打坐恢复气血，运行两遍气血就满了。跟着就开始了今天的修炼任务。江流自己制定了严格的修炼任务。充分利用一切时间，合理分配时间修炼，循序渐进的完成着自己的修炼任务。看着自己一天天的变强，这才能够有足够的安全感。毕竟这个世界是很可怕的。到处有高来高去的高人，强盗，贼匪，野外还有异兽横行。

The latest chapter of Saint: Suppressing Thirteen Prefectures with One Sword_Chapter 19 Initial Assessment Page 1_Sage: Suppressing Thirteen Prefectures with One Sword has a long road ahead_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 19 Initial Assessment (Page 1)
The next day, Jiang Liu hurried to the Apprentice Square early in the morning. After a while, all the forty-two apprentice gangs arrived. Master Ma arrived shortly after him, and then he glanced at the apprentices and turned around and shouted: "Xiao Qing! Open the timing hourglass!" "Yes! Master Ma!" Xiao Qing responded. Master Ma then summoned up his energy and blood and enveloped the whole place with coercion. Soon there were two apprentices who could not bear the pressure of Qi and blood. The husband knelt down and finally lay on the ground. Master Ma turned around and looked at the hourglass. With a wave of his hand, two helpers immediately appeared and pulled the two people down. Master Ma ignored the two apprentices and continued to increase the blood pressure. Soon, one after another, people could not bear the pressure of blood and were forced to kneel down. After a while, people fell down in the square. In the end, only Jiang Liu, Wang Zhuang and Pan Duan were left on the field. Still persisting. After another quarter of an hour or so, Jiang Liu finally couldn't hold on anymore. Before Jiang Liu fell, he saw that he was the only one holding on. Master Ma saw that no one was standing anymore, so he put away his Qi and blood pressure. He glanced at the hourglass and said, "You have been practicing for a month and a half. The first ones who can't bear it are those who haven't entered the meat refining process yet. It's no longer worth the gang spending a lot of resources to train them!" "As for the resources they spent before, why don't they call me home? People double their help to pay off! Or let them work in the gang's chore hall to pay off!" "You should know that every cultivation resource the gang spends on you is hard-earned! I hope you can take care of yourself!" After saying that, Master Ma turned around and walked away gracefully. Jiang Liu looked at Master Ma's retreating back! He thought to himself: This means chasing people away as they say! I don't even give you a greeting! Jiang Liu has actually been in this world for more than half a year. When I first started hanging out on the streets, I knew that gangs did a lot of bad things. Cheating and abduction are normal, and some harvesters and harvesters also happen from time to time. When he first saw this, Jiang Liu was so frightened that he couldn't sleep for several days and had nightmares every night, fearing that he would end up in that situation one day. Fortunately, Jiang Liu was not too young when he crossed over. Otherwise, the end will definitely not be better than those people. Even so, the neighbors next door are planning to come and have a meal. Fortunately, Jiang Liu woke up in time. Otherwise, he would definitely be begging for food now. With such a weak body, he would be bullied by others even if he begged for food. Therefore, Jiang Liu only felt a little sympathy for the two apprentices who were dragged away, and then there was no trouble. After all, the gang has provided such a good environment, but if you don't work hard, who can you blame? When the other apprentices saw this scene, several of them shouted loudly, saying that Master Ma was too ruthless and should give them another chance. Xiaoqing heard such remarks and immediately reprimanded: "Those who are talking about Master Ma behind his back, today's supply of soup and medicine has been halved! Next time, the supply of soup and medicine will be canceled directly for one day. Xiaojie, please write down the list!" "If anyone feels that the punishment is excessive, you can help them make up for the cost. Don't say not to give this. You have a chance!" "Also, don't think you have enough time. Master Ma will continue the assessment next month. If you fail the assessment, you will be treated the same as the two people who were kicked out today. I believe you also know what will happen." After Xiaoqing said this, he stopped caring about these apprentices and left with his hands behind his back. He also has to seize the time to practice. Where do you have so much free time to take care of their business? If you are not here to take care of these apprentices, you can contribute some points and get some benefits. The devil is here! After all, he is a gangsterYes, if your martial arts skills are not good, your life will be in danger at any time, and you don’t know where you will die tomorrow. When the apprentices heard this, they immediately lost interest in continuing the discussion. Everyone started practicing today. After all, if they fail the next assessment, they will be the ones kicked out. Who has the time to care about others? Jiang Liu meditated to restore his qi and blood, and after running his qi and blood twice, he was full. Then today’s training mission began. Jiang Liu himself formulated strict training tasks. Make full use of all your time, allocate your time for cultivation reasonably, and complete your cultivation tasks step by step. Only by watching myself become stronger day by day can I feel safe enough. After all, the world is scary. There are high-ranking people, robbers, thieves and bandits everywhere, and there are also strange animals running rampant in the wild.
